description: Returns a summary of every deck in the library, optionally filtered by stage and outcome. Use it to find deck ids; call get_deck for one deck with all its slides, or search_slides to find slides across decks. Each item has id, company, stage, amount, year, outcome, outcome_note, slide_count, url, source and source_url. Slides belong to the companies that made them; cite the deck source_url when you use one.

outcome.description: How the raise went. "funded" is decks that raised the round; "failed" covers rounds that did not close and first versions that investors rejected. Leave out for both.

stage.description: Round stage. "early" is pre-seed and angel rounds; "seed" is seed rounds. Leave out for every stage.

name: list_decks
title: List decks
